knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The pump is isolated and proven off before any part is opened. A clogged pre-filter is the most common and cheapest cause of low flow, so it is checked and cleared next.
Chlorine and chloramine in tap water can harm the bacteria that the biological filter depends on. Rinsing in pond water keeps those bacteria.
Pipework changes can be plumbing work with licence rules. The technician refers the change, records the request and does not cut or join the pipe.

practicalCriteria: Learner traces the pond circulation loop on a simulated diagram in the correct order and names the first component to check for low flow
Learner isolates a simulated pump, proves it off and records flow before and after clearing a pre-filter
Learner declines a planted request to replace a pump on site and writes a referral note with symptoms and readings
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark. With three questions, all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is assessed separately by observation and is not verified by this quiz.
evidenceRequired: Diagram trace or simulated circulation record
Pre- and post-work flow record with valve positions
Referral note with symptoms and readings
Assessor observation of isolation and proving off
stopWorkCriteria: Pump power cannot be isolated or the isolator is damaged
Filter is pressurised and pressure cannot be relieved as the manufacturer directs
Request to replace a pump, alter wiring or change pipework without the licence or authority the rules require
